en.html:
This was the end of the corridor. The way toward the stern lay open. To go toward the bow, I would have to pull open a large door. There was a door on the right as well. Now then...?
Choices
  • Toward the bow.
  • Toward the stern.
  • Right.
en.text:
This was the end of the corridor.
The way toward the stern lay open. To go toward the bow, I would have to pull open a large door.

There was a door on the right as well.
Now then...?

Choices
• Toward the bow.
• Toward the stern.
• Right.

ja.html:
ここは廊下の終端だ。 　船尾方向には遮るものもなく進めるが、船首方向へ 行くなら大きな扉を引き開けねばならない。 　扉は右側にもある。 　さて……？
選択肢
  • 船首方向へ
  • 船尾方向へ
  • 右へ
